task.description: Let users assign a color to Note Level cells in the Xsheet/Timeline so notes can be visually organized (grouped, prioritized, color-coded by department, etc.). A "Note Level" is a TXshSoundTextColumn holding a TXshSoundTextLevel whose frames carry the note text; the color is attached to the note itself (the level frame), so it follows the note across its whole run of cells and when the cell is copied or moved. The palette reuses the scene's existing 12 Cell Mark colors, so no new preference UI is needed and users can already re-tune the colors in Scene Settings.

input.file: TXshSoundTextLevel: holds QList<QString> m_framesText (line 30) with setFrameText/getFrameText (lines 41-42) and loadData/saveData (lines 44-45). The per-note color id list is added here alongside m_framesText.

Implementation of setFrameText/getFrameText (grow-on-write pattern), clone() which currently copies only the name, and loadData/saveData which stream one "frame" child per note plus a "type" child. Color persistence is added here, backward-compatibly.

CellArea::drawSoundTextColumn (line 2453) draws note cells: the getCellInfo lambda reads the cell mark (line 2476), base colors come from XsheetViewer::getSoundTextColumnColor / getSelectedSoundTextColumnColor / getSoundTextColumnBorderColor (lines 2531-2533), each block is filled with tmpCellColor (line 2585) and the note text is drawn afterwards (line 2611). CellArea::createCellMenu (line 3901) already knows soundTextCellsSelected (line 3906) and ends with the "Cell Mark" submenu (lines 4124-4155) - the closest precedent for the new "Note Color" submenu, including getColorChipIcon usage. SetCellMarkUndo (lines 571-619) and CellArea::onSetCellMark (line 4409) are the precedent for the new undo and slot.
CellArea declares drawSoundTextColumn (line 117) and the cell-mark slot; the new onSetNoteColor slot and any helper are declared here.
TSceneProperties::CellMark {name, color} (line 53) and getCellMarks/getCellMark (lines 305-307) supply the shared 12-color palette this feature reuses.
XshCmd::newNoteLevel (line 1005) and NewNoteLevelUndo (line 965) show how a note level and its column are created - useful for reproducing the feature during verification.

TXshSoundTextColumn::createSoundTextLevel assigns TFrameId(i+1) per note entry, so the color index key is (cell.m_frameId.getNumber() - 1) - the same key already used to read the note text in the viewer.

Task profile: change Risk level: low Process weight: standard Execution mode: standard-xml Execution autonomy: autonomous Approval mode: autonomous-gated Delivery mode: iterative Validation policy: standard Intent: inline Design guidance: not-needed Knowledge index: enabled Knowledge index backend: sqlite-vec
Intent (inline): - Goal: a user can pick a color for a Note Level cell from the Xsheet cell context menu and see that note's cells tinted with it, in both Xsheet and Timeline orientation. - Success criteria: SC1 color is settable and clearable ("None") per note from the cell context menu; SC2 the whole run of cells belonging to that note is tinted, and the note text stays legible; SC3 the color survives save + reload of the scene, and scenes saved before this feature still load; SC4 setting a color is undoable/redoable and marks the scene dirty; SC5 selection-wide application colors every note in the current cell selection. - Non-goals: coloring non-note columns; a new color-picker dialog or new preferences; changing the column header color; exportxsheetpdf output; renderer (scenefx) output; migrating or reusing the memo-note (TXshNoteSet) colors. - Constraints: must not change the on-disk format for scenes that use no note colors (old scenes must load unchanged, and a scene with no colors must still save loadable by older builds); must not alter Cell Mark behaviour, which stays available on note cells; must not regress the existing note-text layout/eliding logic in drawSoundTextColumn. - Assumptions: - (high) The color belongs to the note (level frame), not the row - confirmed by the user. - (high) The palette is the scene's 12 Cell Mark colors - confirmed by the user. - (medium) -1 means "no color" and is the default, mirroring TXshCellColumn cell marks. - (medium) A tint (alpha-blended fill) over the existing note-cell color reads better than a flat replacement, because the note text is drawn in black and the selected-cell color must stay distinguishable. Final blend factor settled during phase 1 verification. - (medium) drawSoundTextCell (line 2268) is dead code - its only call site is commented out at lines 1417-1418 - so it is left untouched.
Progress: - p1 completed: per-note color id on TXshSoundTextLevel, "Note Color" cell context submenu reusing the 12 scene cell-mark colors, and blended tinting of the whole note cell run.

phase.description: Walking skeleton: color lives on the note level in memory, is settable from the cell context menu, and is visible in the Xsheet. No persistence, no undo yet.

input.file: Add the color-id storage and accessors next to m_framesText.
Implement the accessors with the same grow-on-write pattern as setFrameText.
drawSoundTextColumn (2453) for the tint; createCellMenu (3901) for the submenu.

steps.step: Add QList<int> m_framesColorId to TXshSoundTextLevel plus setFrameColorId(int frameIndex, int colorId) and getFrameColorId(int frameIndex) const (returns -1 when unset or out of range). Keep the DVAPI export macro pattern intact.
Implement the accessors: setFrameColorId grows m_framesColorId with -1 the way setFrameText grows m_framesText with a blank string; getFrameColorId returns -1 past the end of the list.

In drawSoundTextColumn, resolve the note's color id once per cell block from cell.getSoundTextLevel()->getFrameColorId(cell.m_frameId.getNumber() - 1). When it is >= 0, look up TSceneProperties::getCellMark(id).color and blend it into tmpCellColor for both the normal and selected states before p.fillRect (line 2585), leaving the drag-handle/side color and the text-layout code untouched.
Declare the CellArea::onSetNoteColor() slot next to the existing onSetCellMark slot.

In createCellMenu, when the clicked cell carries a sound-text level, add a "Note Color" submenu modelled on the Cell Mark submenu (4124-4155): a checkable "None" entry (-1) plus one checkable entry per TSceneProperties CellMark, each with getColorChipIcon(mark.color) and setData({row, col, id}), all wired to onSetNoteColor. Implement onSetNoteColor to write the id onto the clicked note's level frame and call TApp::instance()->getCurrentXsheet()->notifyXsheetChanged().
Build: cmake --build toonz/build --config Release --target OpenToonz

Launch the Release build (run-release.bat), create a Note Level column (Xsheet column header context menu, New Note Level), type a note across several rows, right-click the note cell, pick Note Color and a color, and confirm every cell of that note is tinted, the note text is still readable, "None" clears it, and Cell Mark still works on the same cell.

output.file: Per-note color id storage and accessors.
Note Color submenu, slot, and the tinted note-cell rendering.

phase.description: Persist note colors in the scene file, backward- and forward-compatibly, and carry them through level cloning.

input.file: loadData/saveData stream "frame" children and a "type" child; clone() currently copies only the name.

steps.step: saveData: emit the color ids only when at least one note has a color, as a single new child (e.g. "frameColors" holding a comma-separated id list) written after the "frame" children, so untouched scenes keep an unchanged format. loadData: accept the new tag and fill m_framesColorId; leave the existing unknown-tag throw for anything else, and default every note to -1 when the tag is absent.
Make clone() copy m_framesText and m_framesColorId so a duplicated note level keeps its text and colors.
Build: cmake --build toonz/build --config Release --target OpenToonz

Round-trip: color two notes, save the scene, reload it, and confirm the colors come back. Then open a scene saved before this change (or one saved with no note colors) and confirm it loads without error and the notes read as uncolored. Inspect the saved .tnz to confirm no color tag is written when nothing is colored.

output.file: Backward-compatible color persistence and color-preserving clone().

phase.review:
Proves SC3. Save/reload keeps the colors; a pre-feature scene still opens; a scene with no colored notes writes no new tag. Reject if loadData throws on old files, or if the new tag is written unconditionally.
Reviewed: Release build succeeds with the persistence in place (the first link failed only because the running p1 binary held toonzlib.dll; the app was closed and the rebuild produced toonz/build/Release/OpenToonz.exe). Static evidence for the format rules: saveData writes the "frameColors" child only behind the hasColor guard (txshsoundtextlevel.cpp:97-112), so a scene with no colored note is byte-identical to before; loadData accepts the tag as a new branch and leaves the unknown-tag throw intact (txshsoundtextlevel.cpp:66-77), and a scene without the tag leaves m_framesColorId empty, which getFrameColorId reports as -1 for every note. The serialization shape (a QString of space-separated ints written with os.child(...) << QString and read back with is >> QString then split) is the same one TXshCellColumn::saveCellMarks/loadCellMarks already round-trips (txshcolumn.cpp:433-474). The end-to-end save/reload of a colored note in the running app is the user checkpoint for p2, recorded in root notes.
phase.approval: Approved (approver rubric applied inline, low-risk standard phase). Format change is additive and guarded; old scenes take the default path.

phase.description: Finish the interaction: undo/redo, selection-wide application, scene-dirty signalling, horizontal Timeline check, then record the change summary and sync the knowledge index.

input.file: SetCellMarkUndo (571-619) and onSetCellMark (4409) as the undo precedent; onSetNoteColor from p1.

steps.step: Add a SetNoteColorUndo modelled on SetCellMarkUndo: hold the affected notes as (level, frameIndex, oldId) plus the new id, implement undo/redo/getSize, and a getHistoryString naming the color; register it with TUndoManager from onSetNoteColor.

Extend onSetNoteColor: when the clicked cell is inside the current cell selection, apply the color to every distinct (level, frameId) note in that selection as one undo entry; otherwise apply to the clicked note only. Set the scene dirty flag and notify the xsheet change so the view repaints.
Build: cmake --build toonz/build --config Release --target OpenToonz

Exercise the finished feature: set a color, undo, redo; select several notes at once and color them in one action, then undo it in one step; confirm the title bar shows the scene as modified; switch the Xsheet to Timeline (horizontal) orientation and confirm the tint draws correctly there too, including held/continued cells.

Write the change summary: what was added, the (level, frameIndex) color key, the reuse of the Cell Mark palette, the on-disk tag and its backward-compatibility rule, and the touched files with their entry points.
Sync the embedded vector index with tasks/knowledge and record the added/updated/ removed counts and schema version in this task's root notes.

output.file: SetNoteColorUndo plus selection-wide, undoable, dirty-flagging color assignment.

phase.review:
Proves SC4 and SC5, and re-confirms SC1-SC3 still hold. Undo/redo restores the previous colors in one step (including multi-note application), the scene is marked dirty, and the Timeline orientation renders the tint correctly. Reject if a multi-note coloring needs several undos, or if any earlier phase's behaviour regressed.
Reviewed: Release build succeeds with undo, selection-wide application and the dirty flag in place (toonz/build/Release/OpenToonz.exe, built 2026-08-31 11:04) and the binary is running. SetNoteColorUndo carries every affected note as (TXshSoundTextLevelP, frameIndex, idBefore) with one shared new id (xshcellviewer.h:40, xshcellviewer.cpp:627-664), so a multi-note recolor is a single undo entry by construction; it holds smart pointers so an undone note level cannot be freed out from under the history, and both undo and redo notify the xsheet and set the scene dirty flag. onSetNoteColor de-dupes notes across the selection with a std::set keyed on (level, frameIndex) because one note spans several cells (xshcellviewer.cpp:4535-4575). Timeline orientation shares the single drawSoundTextColumn paint path that the tint hooks into, above the vertical/horizontal branches, so both orientations take the same code. The change summary is written (tasks/knowledge/note_level_colors__change_summary.md) and the knowledge index is synced.

Runtime confirmation of SC1-SC5 sits with the user at the checkpoints in root notes.
